content.title: Is ABC Pulling or Canceling ‘The Bachelorette’? Will Taylor Frankie Paul’s Season Still Air?
content.text: Key PointsThe Bachelorette season 22 remains scheduled despite Taylor Frankie Paul's ongoing investigation.“The investigation will not impact the release schedule or press plans for The Bachelorette.”Production of The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives is paused, fueling fan speculation. UPDATE: In response to a video released by TMZ of Taylor Frankie Paul throwing metal stools at Dakota Mortensen, ABC has announced they are no longer moving forward with The Bachelorette Season 22. Related: ABC Cancels Taylor Frankie Paul’s ‘Bachelorette’ Season With headlines swirling around a new domestic violence investigation involving The Bachelorette star Taylor Frankie Paul and her ex Dakota Mortensen, some fans are wondering: Is ABC going to cancel or pull The Bachelorette season 22?Read More Here’s what we know. Related: Inside ‘Bachelorette’ Star Taylor Frankie Paul’s Life Today — From Scandal to Faith Is ‘The Bachelorette’ Canceled? No. The Bachelorette has not been canceled as of this writing. Season 22 is still scheduled to premiere Sunday, March 22, 2026, on ABC. Parade has reached out to ABC for comment and has not heard back at this time. Yes. Despite the ongoing investigation, there are no plans to delay or cancel the season. According to a report from Variety, the situation will not impact the release schedule or promotional plans for The Bachelorette. In fact, Taylor has been in New York this week promoting the show on Good Morning America and Live with Kelly and Mark. “The investigation will not impact the release schedule or press plans for The Bachelorette,” Variety reports. Related: New ‘Bachelorette’ Promo Teases Major Drama: ‘Get in the Car and Leave’ (Exclusive) Why Are Fans Asking if ‘The Bachelorette’ is Canceled? The questions come after news broke that Taylor and Dakota are involved in an ongoing domestic assault investigation. Authorities have confirmed that: there is an open case allegations have been made “in both directions” police made contact with both parties in late February At the same time, production on The Secret Lives of Mormon Wives—the reality series that follows Taylor’s life—has been paused while the situation unfolds. Those developments have led to widespread speculation online about whether ABC would pull or delay The Bachelorette. Related: ‘The Bachelorette’ Season 22 Cast Revealed: ‘The Book of More-Men’ is Now Open What Have Taylor Frankie Paul and Dakota Mortensen Said About the Situation? In recent interviews, Taylor has acknowledged the situation but said she is focusing on the present moment ahead of the premiere. “Honestly, it’s been a heavy time to see the headlines, especially during this time of The Bachelorette being released, and it’s supposed to be a really exciting time. I’m a person that will always speak my truth and that’s what I’m known for and so when the time is right, I will be. But right now, just trying to be in the present moment and focus on this,” said Taylor in her interview on Good Morning America. Meanwhile, a representative for Dakota told Entertainment Weekly that his focus is on their son. “His number one priority here is protecting [their son], Ever,” the rep said, adding that he wants to co-parent effectively. Related: All the Taylor Frankie Paul ‘Bachelorette’ Spoilers — Including Who Made the Final 3 Could ABC Still Make Changes to the Show? At this point, there is no indication that ABC plans to cancel or alter the season. In fact, the controversy has brought significant attention to the show ahead of its premiere. Reality TV franchises like The Bachelorette often continue airing despite off-screen drama involving cast members, especially when episodes have already been filmed. In fact, ABC might not like the subject of the publicity this week, but it certainly is getting people talking about the show in the week leading up to the premiere.
